Source: https://github.com/SciresM/hactool
Revision: 1d64a83450e025622f3468c28fc4164dad2c5ef6
License: ISC (see LICENSE)
Bundled dependency: mbed TLS 2.6.1 (Apache-2.0; see mbedtls/LICENSE)

The importer links hactool's format and NCA routines into the Android runtime. It does not ship keys or game data.
Local changes: fix unaligned BKTR reads; close and report failed writes and relocation reads; free PFS0 parsing buffers;
do not print key values in parser diagnostics. The Android build redirects CLI exit() calls to the importer's error guard.
The bundled Mbed TLS CMake check reads config.h without rewriting it, so simultaneous builds cannot truncate it.
